answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Verified sculptor society membership with sculptors society attestation flips the bet — a membership the society kept across years of works — and the trellis lands on the attacker instead. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the violet of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The echo is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
